entities.summary: Jakob Forsbacka Karlsson is a Swedish former professional ice hockey player, who played for the Boston Bruins in the National Hockey League (NHL). Nicknamed "JFK", Forsbacka Karlsson was drafted by the Bruins in the second round of the 2015 NHL Entry Draft.
